services.title: Our services
services.subtitle: Four services that cover the life cycle of a pharmaceutical batch, from the production line to the regulatory audit.
services.iot_text: Sensors connected through ThingsBoard capture temperature, humidity and pressure of each piece of equipment and link them to the batch in production.
services.gmp_text: Controlled documents, approval workflows and GMP checks applied to every record, ready for DIGEMID inspections.
services.trace_text: An attributed audit trail connects raw materials, operations, analytical results and finished goods.
services.batch_text: Production orders, master formulas and electronic batch records from issuance to QA release.

features.title: Everything your quality team needs, connected
features.subtitle: Select a feature to see how it works.
features.f1_text: Sensors connected through ThingsBoard send temperature, humidity and pressure readings every minute. Each reading is stored with its equipment and linked automatically to the batch in production, without manual transcription.
features.f2_text: Every controlled document follows a versioned approval workflow with electronic signatures. Before a batch is released, DoofPlus verifies that all GMP prerequisites are complete and attributed.
features.f3_text: Out-of-limit readings open a deviation linked to the affected batch and notify the QA/QC team in seconds, so root-cause analysis and CAPA start immediately.
features.f4_text: Quality and production indicators—batches in progress, open deviations, CAPA on time and release cycle time—in one dashboard for each role.
features.p3_subtitle: Opened automatically from an IoT reading

about.title: DoofPlus: Transforming Pharmaceutical Quality Management with IoT and Regulatory Compliance
about.text: DoofPlus is developed by IngesCompany, a startup that builds digital solutions for highly regulated industries. The platform centralizes the information of manufacturing and quality control processes, giving laboratories organized, reliable records that support compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and DIGEMID requirements.
about.mission_text: Design open technological solutions that digitize and optimize pharmaceutical quality management, integrating operational and IoT data to strengthen traceability, regulatory compliance and process reliability.
about.vision_text: Become a reference in digital quality-assurance solutions for the Latin American pharmaceutical industry, enabling open technologies that improve traceability, data integrity and compliance management.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Select a question to see its answer.
faq.q1: Can QA/QC and Production work in separate views?
faq.a1: Yes. Each segment enters its own environment of the Web Application, with the modules and approvals of its role and links to the records it is authorized to see.
faq.q2: Does DoofPlus certify GMP compliance automatically?
faq.a2: No. DoofPlus supports compliance with GMP and DIGEMID requirements through controlled processes, electronic signatures and an immutable audit trail, but the validation of computerized systems and the final compliance remain the responsibility of each laboratory.
faq.a3: Any device that sends telemetry to ThingsBoard over MQTT or HTTP: temperature, humidity, differential pressure and pH sensors, among others. Each device is registered and associated with its equipment in DoofPlus.
faq.a4: Yes. Laboratories that request a demo can start a 30-day pilot before choosing the Standard Lab or Enterprise plan.
faq.a5: Data is encrypted in transit, access is role-based with two-factor authentication at critical steps, and every change is recorded in the audit trail. Personal data is processed under Peru's Personal Data Protection Law (Law N.° 29733).

legal.terms_intro: These Terms of Service govern the use of DoofPlus, the pharmaceutical quality-management platform developed by IngesCompany, by laboratories that subscribe to it and by their authorized users. By registering an organization or using the platform, the laboratory accepts these terms.
legal.t1_text: DoofPlus provides software for quality documentation, batch traceability, deviations and CAPA, audit trail and IoT monitoring through ThingsBoard. The platform supports controlled processes; computerized-system validation and compliance with GMP and DIGEMID requirements remain the responsibility of each laboratory.
legal.t2_text: The laboratory administrator registers the organization, invites users and assigns their roles. Each user is responsible for keeping their credentials and two-factor authentication confidential. Electronic signatures are personal and non-transferable.
legal.t3_text: Plans (Standard Lab and Enterprise) are billed monthly or annually in US dollars through the payment provider Niubiz. Subscriptions renew automatically unless they are cancelled before the renewal date. Plan limits, such as the number of IoT devices and users, apply as published on the Plans page.
legal.t4_text: Records created by the laboratory belong to the laboratory. DoofPlus keeps an immutable audit trail of every change, with its author, date and reason, and does not modify customer records except at the laboratory's request.
legal.t5_text: IngesCompany develops DoofPlus following the ACM/IEEE Software Engineering Code of Ethics and the Code of Ethics of the Colegio de Ingenieros del Perú (CIP): it acts in the public interest, is transparent about the limits of the product and reports any incident that affects customer data.
legal.t6_text: IngesCompany may update these terms and will notify administrators 30 days in advance. Questions: doofplus.inges@gmail.com · Lima, Perú.
legal.privacy_intro: This policy explains how IngesCompany collects and processes personal data through the DoofPlus Landing Page and Web Application, in accordance with Peru's Personal Data Protection Law (Law N.° 29733) and its regulations.
legal.p1_text: From visitors who request a demo: work email, laboratory name and segment. From users of the Web Application: name, work email, role, plant and the records they create or sign.
legal.p2_text: We use the data to answer demo requests, provide the service, authenticate users, keep the audit trail required by GMP and send service notifications. We do not sell personal data.
legal.p3_text: Data is stored in databases protected with encryption in transit, role-based access and two-factor authentication. Audit-trail records are kept for the retention period required by the laboratory's quality system.
legal.p4_text: We share only the data needed with service providers: ThingsBoard (IoT telemetry), Niubiz (payments) and our cloud provider, under confidentiality agreements.
legal.p5_text: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, cancellation and opposition (ARCO) by writing to doofplus.inges@gmail.com. You may also file a claim with Peru's National Authority for Personal Data Protection.
